svg.text: Hey, I'm Disha - an Information Technology graduate from Banasthali Vidyapith who builds agentic LLM
systems end to end. Previously an AI/ML intern at Icehut Technologies and a web development intern at
Multi-agent workflows in LangGraph, hybrid retrieval pipelines, and FastAPI services with real
databases, event queues and Docker behind them - from the first prompt to the deployed app.
People approve, agents propose. Every decision explains itself. Rules first, the LLM for the gaps.
Idempotency keys, audit logs and ordered writes, so nothing happens twice.
AI / ML engineering roles. Open to relocation across India and to remote work.
